prompts.base: Edit this authored UI reference into a production Wind weapon badge sheet for Bullets of Fury. Use case: style-transfer. The first input is the existing nine weapon icons in a 3 by 3 equal-cell transparent grid, ordered by weapon slot. The second input shows the existing elemental symbol badge style. Preserve the original compact octagonal steel pixel-art frames, black interior panels and small bottom level tag. Produce exactly NINE distinct centered badges in the SAME 3 columns by 3 rows, generous transparent gutters, consistent dimensions and crisp Neo Geo pixel clusters. These are upgrade-menu icons, readable at 48-80 pixels. Change the icon contents to actual FIRED WIND PROJECTILES and effects, pale silver/white cores with emerald/turquoise wind streaks and dark teal outlines. Absolutely no spaceships, gun assemblies, barrels, fans, engine pods or mechanical carriers. Slot order row-major: 0 two elongated fired metal bullets wrapped in little curved wind wisps; 1 five separate pellets fanning NORTH with flowing wind trails; 2 a single actual pointed finned missile angled upward with a curling green gust wake; 3 a slender straight NORTH white-green laser column with short curling airflow along its edges; 4 an expanding upward gust plume/breath made of curved ribbons of air; 5 a compact circular tornado orb with visible silver spiral wind ribbons; 6 a spray of many narrow upward wind needles and mist; 7 two heavy fired slugs with thicker swirling airflow, visibly heavier than slot0; 8 a small round wind-energy sphere with a few sharp electrical forks. All nine have exactly Roman numeral I in the same small bottom tag. Frames match the authored UI references: metallic beveled pixel edges and rivets, dark interior, restrained green elemental accents. The PROJECTILE inside each badge is the focus. No scenery, captions, watermarks, numbers outside the I tags, or screen mockup. Real transparent alpha outside each badge. Equal even-sized cells conceptually256x256; keep complete frames with padding, no clipping or cell overlap.

Inside, a very readable WIND symbol: three sweeping silver-white and pale emerald curved gust lines traveling sideways, their tips curling naturally, recognizably blowing air. Only the elemental wind/gust symbol, no orb weapon, no machinery, no fan, no propeller, no spaceship, no text, no Roman numeral or level tag. Bold silhouette readable at32 pixels. Real transparent alpha outside, padded square even conceptually256x256 canvas, complete centered shape, no background scene, no extra icons or sheet.

Column order LEFT TO RIGHT is II, III, IV, V. Change ONLY the small bottom level-tag Roman numeral and add restrained emerald upgrade pips to the frame matching the attached original authored II-V tier reference. Numerals must be exactly II then III then IV then V across EVERY row. No extra numeral I badges. Keep same fixed centered position, same even square cell, clear transparent gutters and padded complete outlines. Crisp small pixel-art clusters; enough room for readable tags; no overlapping rows or clipped frames. All 9 rows are required, including two distinguishable circular orb rows and the wide Wind mist row. Suggested concept dimensions:128-pixel cells,512 wide1152 tall.
